summary: Independent review: structure, ontology terms, file mapping and design check out against PRIDE, the mqpar.xml/experimentalDesign of oldworms.7z, raw headers and the paper. One important omission is left: the digest was trypsin + Lys-C (paper Supplemental Experimental Procedures and PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol), but only Trypsin is declared. The producer recorded this as a limitation, and its own reconcile step flagged it MAJOR.

reviewer_context.context: fresh isolated subagent; no producer transcript; producer manifest/report treated as untrusted and re-checked against primary sources fetched or re-read by the reviewer

spec_compliance.evidence: 39 columns in ms-proteomics 1.2.0 + invertebrates 1.1.0 order (sdrf-pipelines bundled templates; spec submodule only carries ms-proteomics 1.1.0, but v1.2.0 is used by 70k+ rows in the repo); sdrf-tools structure OK; no reserved-word misuse; (source name, assay name, label) unique over 72 rows; 4 modification columns and 2 sdrf template columns are legal multiples.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Reviewer resolved each term in OLS4, and none is obsolete: NCBITaxon:6239, BTO:0001489 whole body, MONDO:0005180, PATO:0000461, EFO:0001272 adult, MS:1002416 Orbitrap Fusion, PRIDE:0000627, MS:1000422, MS:1000264, MS:1001251, PRIDE:0000608, PRIDE:0000599, UNIMOD:1/35/259/4 (labels exact, no Acetyl/Phospho swap). material type 'whole organism' is in the fixed enum. sdrf-tools check reports 16/16 verified, CLEAN.

source_evidence.evidence: Paper identity was confirmed in Europe PMC (DOI 10.1016/j.celrep.2016.08.025 -> PMID 27626671). The strain list, genotypes, day-5 adult pulse at 6/24/48 h, whole-worm lysis, DTT/IAA, Orbitrap Fusion Top Speed DDA with HCD 30% and ion-trap MS2 all match the Supplemental Experimental Procedures. The reviewer range-read the raw headers of N2_48h_AF and OW40_6h_WF: Orbitrap Fusion, HCD, CE 30, IonTrap MS2, scan range 400-1500. mqpar.xml (36 matching filePaths) gives Trypsin/P, 4.5 ppm, ITMS 0.5 Da, Carbamidomethyl fixed, Acetyl (Protein N-term) and Oxidation (M) variable, and Lys8 with multiplicity 2. Exception: Lys-C is omitted (finding 1).

file_mapping.evidence: The reviewer fetched PRIDE files/all (projectAccessions == {PXD004561}): 82 .raw files. The artifact's 36 raw files all exist, none is duplicated within a label, and all are vendor .raw. The sibling developing SDRF holds 32 different raw files with zero overlap. The 14 runs 20141107_F1_HRV_SM_B1-B7 and C1-C7 are in neither file; they come from a 7-time-point design, so they cannot be day-5 runs, which have 3 time points.

design_consistency.evidence: 6 strains x 3 pulse times = 18 conditions x 2 fractions x 2 SILAC channels = 72 rows, which matches the experimentalDesignTemplate.txt (36 runs, 18 experiments, AF=fraction 1, WF=fraction 2). AF and WF use the same MS method and differ only in the LC gradient (%B 10/28/45 vs 7/25/40), which fits two peptide fractions of one digest. bio rep = 1 is consistent with one well per strain/time.

omission_safety.evidence: The reviewer traced every value to a cited source. No values were added beyond the evidence: the generic Orbitrap Fusion term was used where PRIDE says ETD, and the raw header does not distinguish the ETD model. The omission pass did find that the evidenced Lys-C was left out (finding 1); this is recorded as an important finding rather than a failed pass.

deterministic_validation.evidence: Reviewer ran: flock parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t invertebrates -> exit 0, warnings only (strain names not in NCBITaxon; free-text strain column, expected); sdrf-tools structure exit 0; sdrf-tools check exit 0 CLEAN 16/16; sdrf-tools score 100/100.

findings.message: Lys-C is missing: only NT=Trypsin;AC=MS:1001251 is declared, but the samples were digested with trypsin + Lys-C (Promega).
findings.evidence: Supplemental Experimental Procedures: '100 ng trypsin + Lys-C (Promega) was added'. PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol says the same. sdrf-tools reconcile reports MAJOR cleavage_agent_incomplete. 1763 SDRFs in this repo carry repeated cleavage agent columns.
findings.correction: Add a second comment[cleavage agent details] column next to the first, with NT=Lys-C;AC=MS:1001309 (OLS-verified) on all 72 rows. Do this through the build pipeline, extending it if needed, then re-validate and re-review.

findings.message: PRIDE declares Orbitrap Fusion ETD (MS:1002417); the parent term MS:1002416 is defensible because the raw header names 'Orbitrap Fusion' and the method is HCD-only.
findings.evidence: PRIDE project instruments; raw method summary

findings.message: Light and heavy channels of one pulsed population carry distinct source names (_Lys0/_Lys8). This is acceptable for row-coordinate uniqueness but makes one population look like two biological sources.
The meaning of AF/WF is undocumented. The gradient difference supports treating them as two peptide fractions, but no fractionation method is recorded.
